subject: Renewal sync: usage spike, perf scorecard & extension pathway
messages:

Subject: Renewal check-in + Q2 surge questions

Hi Rishi —

Quick note ahead of renewal: we saw a ~3.6x spike in token consumption during May–Jun after launching new summarization flows. That drove our average monthly spend above the committed run-rate and we also observed increased p95 latency on a small subset of inference 3.1 endpoints.

Can we do a short usage & performance review next week? Procurement will want clarity on:
- a clear ROI recap (savings from prefix caching and KV reuse)
- options for a 12 vs 24 month extension and any volume discounts
- what a short-term burst capacity add-on would cost and how it affects SLA

Thanks — happy to share our internal usage export if helpful.

—Morgan

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Blake <morgan.blake@citeai.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-27T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: CiteAI Q2 perf + cost scorecard (attached)

Hi team — attaching two artifacts: q2_inference_perf_scorecard.pdf and cost_sensitivity_matrix.xlsx. High-level takeaways below.

Summary (short):
- Consumption: May–Jun spike concentrated in chat/generation flows for two feature flags; 68% of incremental tokens were short prompts with heavy decoding (long-tail token churn).
- Cache impact: prefix/KV caching shows a 21% effective token reduction on warm requests — potential to recover ~11% of current overage if applied aggressively to the new flows.
- Latency: p50=72ms (stable), p95 increased from 430ms -> 610ms on affected endpoints at peak. Root cause: burst concurrency on a model variant with lower optimized kernels + decreased KV hit rate.
- ROI: Using your reported revenue per session, we estimate net saving of $14k/mo after implementing caching + a small model switch (same accuracy) versus cost of adding a dedicated burst slab.

Recommendations:
1) Short term (30–45 days): enable expanded prefix cache policy for the flagged flows and route to the optimized model variant we validated last month. Expect p95 improvement to ~480ms and ~10–12% token spend drop.
2) Renewal offer: consider a 24-month commit with a 15% MSD (multi-year subscription discount) + 10% burst credits (usable overrun buffer) — this materially reduces effective unit cost and gives room for predictable throughput.
3) If CiteAI prefers 12 months, propose a smaller discount but add a paid burst tranche and a 30-day SLA credit for any p95 > 500ms during peak weeks.

Attachments: q2_inference_perf_scorecard.pdf (charts: hit rates, latency percentiles, model variant comparison) and cost_sensitivity_matrix.xlsx (sensitivity of unit cost to token mix and burst usage).

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

- Clarify exact burst credit accounting (how credits are applied to overage invoices).

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in + Q2 surge questions — proposed offer and next steps

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Below is the proposed pathway that aligns with Monica's recommendations and covers the procurement asks. Happy to push this into a DocuSign once CiteAI signals preference.

Offer (summary):
- 24-month commit (baseline tokens = previous 12 mo trailing avg), 15% multi-year discount applied to baseline consumption.
- 10% burst credits granted at contract start (auto-applied to overage invoices until exhausted).
- Operational SLA: 99.9% uptime, p95 target of <=500ms. If p95 >500ms for any rolling 7-day window, automatic service credit of 5% for that month.
- 12-month alternative: 8% discount, configurable paid burst tranche at $0.XX per 1k tokens, and SLA credit on request.

Attachments we've shared: q2_inference_perf_scorecard.pdf, cost_sensitivity_matrix.xlsx. Karhtik will follow with a redline-ready amendment and line-item pricing by EOD tomorrow.

Requested next steps / timeline:
1) CiteAI indicates preference for 12 vs 24 by 2026-09-03 EOD.
2) Redwood shares redline amendment + DocuSign link (karhtik) — target 2026-09-04.
3) Procurement reviews and signs — target 2026-09-08.

Related links: HubSpot HS-98321 (internal deal), DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/link/to/CITE-4521-offer

If you want to discuss on a quick call, I'm available 9/2 11:00–13:00 PT.

Best,
